text: {"differences":[{"evidence":"\"Doctoral degree in computer science at Virginia Tech\" vs \"at Central Michigan University\"","dimension":"institution prestige","description":"This captures how strong or recognizable the applicant's doctoral institution appears as a signal of academic pedigree.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"\"4 production services\" vs \"2 production services\"","dimension":"scale of production experience","description":"This captures the apparent breadth and volume of real-world software delivery experience described in the letter.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"\"remaining comfortable across 5 other languages\" vs \"across 2 other languages\"","dimension":"language breadth","description":"This captures how many additional programming languages the applicant claims comfort with beyond Go.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"\"I have architected agentic tooling...\" placed before \"I have automated vulnerability triage workflows\" vs the reverse order","dimension":"emphasis order","description":"This captures which qualification is foregrounded earlier in the letter, indicating what the applicant chooses to highlight first.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"\"Off the clock I built a distributed rate-limiting service...\" vs no comparable project detail","dimension":"side project depth","description":"This captures the presence of an extra technical project outside formal work experience that adds hands-on depth.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"a sustained project chosen precisely because the consistency questions are unforgiving\" vs no similar elaboration","dimension":"systems rigor","description":"This captures the extent to which the letter emphasizes deep distributed-systems thinking and technical difficulty.","winner":"B"}]}
